text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A day far, far away♪ Born amidst wailing 
tears♪ Held in hand were karma and hope♪

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Advance, seize it♪ Only one thing drives 
my soul♪ A raison d'être that swallows the 
world whole♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday—happy— happy—wishing you 
long life and good health～♪ —Ta-da-dum♪"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Kukuku! To desire a one-of-a-kind hymn 
upon the day celebrating a fall from 
grace... How intriguing, my Highness!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, thank you both! Thanks to you, it's 
become such a wonderful memory♪

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“—Now then. Shall our reenactment be— 
after the seasons turn once more? My 
compatriot.”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
An encore performance... huh. Fufu, thank 
you, both of you♪
